name: BPMN & DMN Modeler (Beta)
description: Beta. Open .bpmn and .dmn files as diagrams: view, simulate and lightly model BPMN processes and DMN decisions, and see an agent's changes to the file as they happen. No deployment, code links or Form editor yet.

cover.alt: Miragon Modeler for BPMN & DMN: processes and decisions from plain .bpmn and .dmn files, edited by you and your agents.
